Subject: TheraHealth Private Deploy - Fee & Support ask

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the team was impressed with the latency and the deterministic failover story. Procurement asked me to send a concise summary of our asks so we can move to a PO quickly. High level:

- We need the private/VPC package for our three clinical sites and a short pilot in Q3.
- Requesting a full waiver of the platform fee for year 1 (we will pay node/license fees).
- Asking for a 40% discount on list for the first 12 months (we plan to convert to committed volume if pilot meets uptime).
- Migration credit to cover data transfer and SRE time (TBD, ballpark $100k).
- SOC 2 and audit evidence — legal will want the reports before signature.

We have a hard procurement deadline of June 4 to get this into our Q3 budget. Can you send a commercial term sheet + SOW draft and a DocuSign link?

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Owens
Director, Cloud Procurement
TheraHealth

Subject: Re: TheraHealth Private Deploy - Fee & Support ask

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear summary and the deadline flag. Appreciate the urgency; I pulled together a commercial response we can put on the table today so your procurement loop has something concrete.

Commercial summary (initial):
- License/Node: list pricing with a 25% introductory discount for the first 12 months.
- Platform fee: $150,000 annual platform fee (covers control plane, observability retention, model catalog support). We can offer a conditional waiver of the platform fee for Year 1 if both of the following are met by month 6 after go-live: 1) conversion to committed run-rate (signed committed baseline) and 2) platform usage adoption of >= 5M tokens/day aggregated (approx 150M tokens/month). If both conditions met we will credit the $150k back to your account within 30 days.
- Migration credit: we can offer a $75,000 migration credit (applied as a one-time invoice credit).
- Support: Standard Enterprise SRE (24x7) included with the package; SLA uplift (4 hr P1 response + 99.9% uptime SLO) is available as an add-on. Uplift can be included for the pilot period on a 6-month term at an incremental $25k.
- SOC2: we will provide our latest SOC2 Type II report and support legal with the standard compliance pack.

Attached a draft SOW (TD_SOW_Draft_v1.pdf) and a DocuSign starter (link below). If procurement accepts the conditional-waiver approach, we will drop the platform fee on the initial invoice and include the credit clause in the SOW and T&Cs.

DocuSign (starter): https://docusign.example.com/therahealth/packet-12345
Drive: https://drive.example.com/drive/folders/therahealth-sow

Happy to jump on a brief call this afternoon to walk through the thresholds.

—Olga

Olga — thanks for the quick reply. A couple of clarifications from our side:

- The procurement committee will only accept a reduction in the platform fee if it is effectively zero for Year 1; conditional credits are harder for our accounting to accept.
- If you cannot waive the platform fee, we want the migration credit increased to $120k (to cover third-party integrator fees).
- We need the SOW to explicitly state data-handling and evidence delivery timelines for SOC2 artifacts.
- We can accept a limited SLA uplift for the pilot, but it must be in the base contract after conversion.

We can do a pilot PO by June 4 if the numbers clear. Legal will return redlines to elliot.black@therahealth.com by May 28.

Thanks,
Procurement Team

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 24 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: TheraHealth private deploy - fee & support ask

Marissa/Karthik — looping you both in. Procurement is pushing for a full Year 1 platform fee waiver (they said conditional credits are painful for internal accounting) and are asking for $120k migration credit if we don't. They also want the SLA uplift to be in the base contract after conversion. Deadline: June 4 for a pilot PO.

My posture proposal (what I think we can offer without losing margin):
- Move from 25% -> 30% introductory discount on license for 12 months (makes the list number friendlier).
- Platform fee: propose a split — bill $75k upfront then credit $75k back on conversion OR fully waive the $75k if they sign conversion within 3 months. Keeps some revenue recognition but gives them 'waiver' language.
- Migration credit: drop to $75k (from their requested $120k).
- SLA uplift: offer at no incremental cost for the 3-month pilot, but require conversion to keep uplift in base contract.

Questions: 1) Can we legally commit to a credit-within-30-days clause? 2) From finance/accounting perspective, is the split-bill approach okay for recognition? 3) Any objection on the $75k migration cap?

—Olga

Subject: Re: Fwd: TheraHealth private deploy - fee & support ask

Thanks for the summary, Olga. I support the split (bill $75k / credit $75k) as long as we include tight conversion criteria and an exec sponsor sign-off clause. Finance gave the following guidance:

- Migration credit capped at $75k.
- Credit applied only after a signed conversion order and verification of adoption thresholds (we will define a telemetry-based check in the SOW).
- The credit-within-30-days is acceptable, but require a 90-day clawback window for any fraudulent/invalid conversion events.
- SLA uplift for pilot at no cost is OK but should expire automatically unless conversion signed.

I'll approve the commercial posture subject to legal inserting the telemetry verification language and finance sign-off on the amortization schedule. Marissa

Subject: Final commercial position and next steps — TheraHealth Private Deploy

Hi Sarah / Procurement team — thank you for your patience while we worked this through internally. Below is our final, binding commercial position for the pilot-to-production path: 

Offer (final):
- License pricing: 30% off list for the first 12 months.
- Platform fee: $75,000 billed upfront for Year 1. The platform fee will be fully waived (100% credited) if, within 90 days after go-live, TheraHealth signs a conversion order and the adoption verification (telemetry check: >= 120M tokens aggregated across sites in any consecutive 30-day window) is met. If conversion occurs but telemetry threshold not met, credit will be prorated.
- Migration credit: $75,000 (one-time invoice credit applied to the pilot invoice).
- SLA uplift: included at no additional charge for the 3-month pilot. Post-pilot SLA uplift will require conversion.
- SOC2: we will provide our latest SOC2 Type II report and an evidence delivery schedule in the SOW.

Next steps:
1) I attached an updated SOW (TD_SOW_Draft_v2.pdf) that includes the telemetry verification clause and the credit mechanics.
2) DocuSign starter link: https://docusign.example.com/therahealth/packet-12345 (please review; legal redlines welcome).
3) If approved by procurement, we will issue the pilot invoice with the migration credit applied and a $0 net due if the credit covers it.

We are available for a 30-minute contract call tomorrow to walk legal through the telemetry language. Please let me know a time that works.

Best,
